title: PERCENTAGE OF FOODGRAINS LIFTED OUT OF TOTAL ALLOCATIONS WAS LOWER FOR PMGKAY-VI COMPARED TO PREVIOUS PHASES
description:
| Period | Allocations (in lakh tons) | Offtake (in lakh tons) | Percentage of foodgrains lifted out of total allocations |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| PMGKAY-I (Apr-Jun 2020) | 120 | 117 | ~98% |
| PMGKAY-II (Jul-Nov 2020) | 200 | 188 | ~94% |
| PMGKAY-III (May-Jun 2021) | 80 | 78 | ~98% |
| PMGKAY-IV (Jul-Nov 2021) | 199 | 193 | ~97% |
| PMGKAY-V (Dec 21-Mar 2022) | 159 | 153 | ~96% |
| PMGKAY-VI (Apr-Sep 2022) | 239 | 200 | ~84% |
| PMGKAY-VII (Oct-Dec 2022) | 120 | 83 | ~69% |
